title: A view-only user can reorder technician columns and Unassigned stays first
custom_preconds:
1. In the top bar, choose the location you test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (the display switcher only shows at 1024 px and wider).
  3. Create a view-only user (skip if one exists):
    • Settings > Roles & Permissions > Create custom role > Skip > Role name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST WO View Only") > tick only View on the Work Orders card > Create.
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Viewer", an email inbox you can open) with that role at the test location, and finish the invite so the user can sign in.
    • Sign this user in later in a second browser or a private window.
  4. The location has these eligible technicians (examples): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo", "ZZAUTOTEST Cal Charlie".
    • A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > open the staff member > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, the Time Clock (clockable) setting is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location.
    • To add one: Settings > Staff > add a staff member with those settings (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha").
  5. How to create each work order below:
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the customer (add it from the window if it does not exist, e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Alpha Co") and any asset > Create.
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician to the technician named (leave it empty for an unassigned one).
    • Move it to the status named: a new work order starts as Estimate; approve the estimate for Approved; use the status control on the work order page for In Progress, Review (Ready for Review) and Complete; decline the estimate for Declined; Finance tab > Create Invoice for Invoiced; record a payment for the full amount for Paid. Set the lead technician before invoicing.
    • Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801).
  6. Work orders: lead Ana — "ZZAUTOTEST Alpha Co"; no lead — "ZZAUTOTEST Golf Co" (both Approved).
  7. No technician is pinned for the view-only user.
custom_steps:
1. Sign in as the view-only user (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST Viewer).
  2. Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab.
  3. Type "ZZAUTOTEST" in Search so only your test work orders show.
  4. Click Board View in the display switcher (the design tooltip reads "Board").
  5. Write down the column order (initially Unassigned first, then technicians by first name: Ana, Ben, Cal).
  6. Press on the drag handle at the left of Cal's column header (tooltip "Drag to reorder technicians") and drag Cal's column before Ana's, then release.
  7. Try to drag Ben's column to the left of the Unassigned column and release there.
  8. Try to press on the Unassigned column header and drag it to the right of Cal.
  9. Click Tech View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar (the design tooltip reads "By Lead Tech").
  10. Try to drag Ben's group header above the Unassigned group and release there.
  11. Refresh the page (F5) and read the technician order in Tech View and in Board View.
  12. In another browser, sign in as the dispatcher (create and edit user), open Work Orders > All > Board View and read the technician order.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: the view-only user can drag a technician column. The order becomes Unassigned, Cal, Ana, Ben.
  • Step 7: Ben cannot be placed before Unassigned. Unassigned stays the first column.
  • Step 8: the Unassigned column cannot be dragged.
  • Step 10: in Tech View, Unassigned stays the first group and Ben cannot be dropped above it.
  • Step 11: after the refresh the view-only user still sees Unassigned, Cal, Ana, Ben in both views.
  • Step 12: the dispatcher's own technician order is unchanged (Unassigned, Ana, Ben, Cal) because the order is saved per user.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10052 (Story 9, Drag to reorder work and technician groups/columns); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S9-R2, S9-R8, read 8 Oct 2026. Story 9 prerequisite and Key Decisions (Permissions), same PRD. Tech plan (revised 24 Sep 2026) Phase 9 drop rules.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R2: “Users with Work Orders view permission can reorder technician groups and columns. The order is saved per user.”
  • S9-R8: “Keep Unassigned fixed during technician reordering.”
  • Story 9 prerequisite: “View permission permits technician-only group/column reordering.”
  • Key decision: permissions: “Permissions. Work Orders view permits viewing all four filter tabs and reordering technician groups/columns.”
  • Tech plan Phase 9 drop rules: “technician-group drags stay inside their area — pinned technicians reorder only among pins, and Unassigned is never a technician drop target (S9-R8, S9-R9)”
